changelog: Full Firestick D-pad remapping across all screens — every button navigates correctly
Guide: ENTER now correctly opens program details instead of accidentally going Home
Guide: Channel cells are now individually D-pad focusable and selectable
Guide: UP/DOWN on programs directly zaps to adjacent channels (200+ channel support)
Player: Subtitle and audio track pickers use correct LibVLC track IDs
Player: Control bar navigation is now circular — wraps around from last button to first
Settings: New DVR Storage Location section with USB/OTG drive picker
Settings: 'Choose Drive' button lists Internal Storage and all connected USB OTG drives
Settings: 'Choose Folder' button opens full SAF folder browser for any drive
Settings: DVR storage path persisted across app restarts via ContentResolver permissions
Accounts: Added account type tagging — mark accounts as Live TV, DVR Only, or All Features
Accounts: Account type badge shown on every account card in the account switcher
Intro video now plays on first launch only — no more video on every cold start
Fixed: AccountEditorDialog now saves accountType correctly when creating/editing accounts
notes: Update apkUrl to your actual hosting URL and replace sha256 values after uploading APKs.
